newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank-fundamentals signal stronger crown.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank-fundamentals signal stronger crown.

text.p: The deputy governor of Sweden's central bank, Lars Heikensten, said on Wednesday that economic fundamentals signalled the crown should strengthen from current levels.
"What we can estimate is that the crown can be stronger," Heikensten told a seminar.
Heikensten said the weak crown prevented the Riksbank from lowering its key interest rate, the repo rate, at the start of this year.
"We have seen some signs that the business cycle has been a little weaker," he said.
"On the other hand the crown has weakened. The exchange rate is an important factor and it is one of the things that can change quickest."
